divergences.description: The package classes do not inherit from or alias docxtpl classes; isinstance and issubclass do not relate them.
docxtpl RichText, RichTextParagraph, Listing and InlineImage instances are ordinary Python objects to the engine, not package values; they render through their own string protocols.
Image construction reads the globals of docxtpl_native.inline_image instead of docxtpl.inline_image; subdocument composition reads the globals of docxcompose.
Rendered XML that libxml2's recover mode would truncate keeps entity references and stray & and < in the text; docxtpl drops them.
A copied list's w:nsid is derived from its definition instead of drawn from Python's random, so output is reproducible.
The command line is python -m docxtpl_native; its usage line names this module.
send/throw/close delegation does not match the reference: async-generator hooks, legacy throw warnings per delegation layer, reentry checks and unraisable reporting.
The SystemError text for an invalid escape result depends on CPython call-site specialization and profiling state; the native call reports the unspecialized message.
A custom join observes a different generator (reference count, code object or caller frame) than the one indent passes in the reference.
An exact code clone of markupsafe.escape is treated as the standard algorithm instead of a user callback.
Awaitables from recursive loops and super() do not expose the reference's generated coroutine code name or code object.

Calls of self.<block> with keyword names the compiler adds inside loops (_loop_vars) raise SyntaxError in Jinja's generated Python code; the native template has no generated code (scope review: CPython code generation).
A replaced Template.from_code is not called; the native compiler builds templates without it, so its builtins and side effects are not observed.

Environment.cache is not called: Jinja stores Python-compiled Template objects in it, which the native compiler does not produce. Reload rules (cache None or replaced, auto_reload with the loader's uptodate) are followed natively.

tojson executes Jinja's Python do_tojson and htmlsafe_json_dumps (native audit). Porting them would remove the Python frames that test_serializer_error_preserves_jinja_traceback_frames requires in the traceback, and change the reference-count observations of the frames' kwargs.
A missing import keeps one extra reference to its target during the callback.
The attribute getter passed by join is a native object, not a function, and the async adapter runs its Python __anext__ body.
A mapping used as Context.vars is read from the native body instead of get_exported.
An exact code clone of AsyncLoopContext._to_iterator installed before the extension loads is indistinguishable from the original and runs natively.
A replaced async loop factory observes a different reference count during its call.
A replaced auto_aiter imported by Jinja's generated module lives until the module's reference cycle is collected; the native render releases it when the render ends.
Contradictory requirements: an async loop repr must not run AsyncLoopContext.__repr__ in Python, and its unawaited length coroutine's warning must point into that __repr__.
